Text.Text: The bunker is free of his orders. Remember who your own orders are meant to serve. Dismissed. You've finished my Decisive Command trials. I have no further work for you here.
This assignment requires rank 50 in Leadership. Build that command experience, then report back. People need orders they can trust.

My old adjutant sealed the engineering bunker and kept the garrison. His junior officers are training obedience through fear. Recover their duty record. Defeat six Decisive Command Adepts in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Decisive Command Republic Bunker Docket; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck. I'll give you the Viscara Republic Engineering Bunker Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Decisive Command.

Here's the Viscara Republic Engineering Bunker Key. Use 'Republic Engineering Bunker' in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Decisive Command Adepts, then return with the Decisive Command Republic Bunker Docket.

A decision is a weapon the same way a blade is: it only cuts if it arrives. Decisive command means your order lands before fear does - yours or theirs. Hesitate, and fear gives the order instead, and fear is a mutineer by nature. I hate hesitation more than error. An error can be corrected by the next order. Hesitation teaches the room there might not be one.

Halden Rhee. Twelve years my adjutant, and the finest executor of orders I ever signed for. When I retired, the Republic gave him the bunker to decommission. Instead he sealed it and built a chain of command that answers to him alone. The soldiers inside are not evil. They are obedient - which is worse, because it is almost the virtue I taught them.

The docket is their operations record - watch rotations, drill schedules, punishment details. Every order Rhee has issued since he went dark, countersigned by officers who should have refused. It is evidence, and it is a map of who below deserves a court and who deserves a grave. Bring it to me intact.

Defeat six Decisive Command Adepts in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Decisive Command Republic Bunker Docket; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck.
You've defeated six Decisive Command Adepts. Let me see the Decisive Command Republic Bunker Docket.
Record recovered. We can trace the orders now. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists control the shield grid. Recover the relay so we can see how they've altered it. Defeat five Decisive Command Specialists in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Decisive Command Shield Grid Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck.
Your key still grants access to Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Defeat five Decisive Command Specialists to secure the Decisive Command Shield Grid Relay, then return to me.

It is - and I am glad you said it, because heroes never do. I sent heroes out alone twice in my career, and I wrote both eulogies. Heroes hesitate for an audience; teams do not. Take at least one steady gun down there and practice being obeyed. The bunker is a better classroom than any parade ground.

The relay is a fist-sized Republic component that decides where the shield's power goes. Rhee cannot replace it - the pattern is licensed to the engineering corps, and the corps thinks the bunker is empty. Take it, and his screen is a memory. It is also proof for my report. Mutineers with a live shield grid are a fortress. Mutineers without one are criminals in a basement.

Rhee's veterans - the ones who sealed the door with him on the first day. They hold their posts the way I taught them to: in pairs, overlapping arcs, no gaps for sentiment. Expect discipline, not madness. And expect them to test your voice. They have obeyed one man for years, and part of every one of them is waiting to hear whether yours carries further.

Defeat five Decisive Command Specialists in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Decisive Command Shield Grid Relay; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck.
You've defeated five Decisive Command Specialists. Let me see the Decisive Command Shield Grid Relay.
Equipment recovered. Their training operation is disrupted. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden enforces the adjutant's orders. Recover his command crest and break that authority. Defeat the Decisive Command Warden in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Decisive Command Cracked Command Crest; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Decisive Command Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Decisive Command Cracked Command Crest.

Vhon was my breach officer. Where other captains planned, she decided - the door opened and she was already through it, and her people followed because following her was safer than thinking. Rhee promised her a command with no committees and no court-martials for being right too fast. I understand why she took it. I will still hold the door at her funeral.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Decisive Command Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

The crest was the bunker's commission - the Republic's mark of command, worn by whoever answered for the garrison. Rhee cracked it in front of the assembled ranks and said the Republic's half was dead weight. He gave the split thing to Vhon like a medal. Bring it back, and the Republic's half starts weighing something again.

Defeat the Decisive Command Warden in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Decisive Command Cracked Command Crest; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Decisive Command Warden. Let me see the Decisive Command Cracked Command Crest.
Warden defeated. That breaks their enforcement. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four officers still control the bunker's supplies. Take their override chip out of circulation. Defeat four members of the Decisive Command Inner Circle in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Decisive Command Quartermaster Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck.

Your key still grants access to Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Defeat four members of the Decisive Command Inner Circle to secure the Decisive Command Quartermaster Override Chip, then return to me.

Understand what you have taken from him so far. The docket proved his orders. The relay was his wall. The crest was his claim to legitimacy. The chip is his ability to feed the people who obey him. After tonight, every soldier in that bunker will know their next meal depends on the Republic's mercy and not on Rhee's signature. Watch how fast obedience remembers its oath.

Two of the four came from my old command - Puren, who could route supply through a war zone in his sleep, and Task, who never once filed late. The other two are Rhee's inventions, promoted for loyalty and taught to count second. Do not rank them by their paperwork. In those vaults, all four will fight like the food depends on it. It does.

Expect the discipline of people who know exactly how many rounds sit on every shelf around them. They will spend ammunition like misers, make you bleed for corners, and fall back through doors they have rehearsed. Bring the team from the breach - rested, fed, and drilled on your voice. Store rooms forgive nothing done alone.

Defeat four members of the Decisive Command Inner Circle in Viscara, Republic Engineering Bunker. Their defeat secures the Decisive Command Quartermaster Override Chip; bring it back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck.
You've defeated four members of the Decisive Command Inner Circle. Let me see the Decisive Command Quartermaster Override Chip.
Their officers no longer control the authorizations. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the source of those orders. Defeat him in the command room and end the garrison's occupation. Defeat the Decisive Command Master in Viscara, Engineering Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Viscara, Engineering Command Room, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Decisive Command Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.
In Viscara, Engineering Command Room, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Decisive Command Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker.

Afterward, the garrison surrenders. I know those soldiers; they are waiting for permission. The Republic reoccupies the bunker, the courts sort the countersigners, and the docket you brought me decides who was coerced. And I file my last report, which will say that decisive command survived Halden Rhee because someone learned it clean. I do not put names in reports lightly. Yours will be in this one.

Keep your own plan when he starts issuing orders. Bring companions who can act without waiting for you to recover from every setback. Defeating him completes the trial; then report back to me to settle the assignment.

Defeat the Decisive Command Master in Viscara, Engineering Command Room. Report back to me here in Viscara, Republic Base, Combat Deck; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Decisive Command Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The bunker is free of his orders. Remember who your own orders are meant to serve. Dismissed. You've earned the right to train Decisive Command. Your final payment is ready.
Run the briefing again.
I'll defeat six Decisive Command Adepts.
What is decisive command, to you?
Who turned your bunker?
What is in this docket you want so badly?
Not yet. I don't take orders I can't execute today.
Here's the Decisive Command Republic Bunker Docket.
Give me the grid briefing again.
I'll defeat five Decisive Command Specialists.
This sounds like more than one gun's work.
What exactly is the relay?
What kind of soldiers am I facing?
Not yet. My squad isn't ready.
Here's the Decisive Command Shield Grid Relay.
Take me through the breach again.
I'll defeat the Decisive Command Warden.
Who is Captain Vhon?
Would you recommend bringing help?
What is the story behind the crest?
Not yet. I won't spend a team I haven't drilled.
Here's the Decisive Command Cracked Command Crest.
Go over the stores again.
I'll defeat four members of the Decisive Command Inner Circle.
What does the chip actually cut?
Who am I killing down there?
How will they fight in the vaults?
Not yet. My people need food and sleep - you taught me that math.
Here's the Decisive Command Quartermaster Override Chip.
Brief me on Rhee once more.
I'll face the Decisive Command Master and report back.
Where did it start? What turned him?
What happens to the garrison when he falls?
How do I fight a voice I want to obey?
Not yet. When we go, we go rested and in force.
The Decisive Command Master is defeated. Here's my report.
